eb3.meta_desc: Learn about the EB-3 Other Workers (unskilled) green card: eligibility, the 5-step process, and an estimated 4–6 year timeline. Free eligibility check with MannaOS.
eb3.featured_desc: No degree required. For people in Vietnam and people already in the U.S. seeking adjustment of status.
eb3.hero_title: Get a U.S. Green Card through EB-3 Other Workers
eb3.hero_sub: No degree or fluent English required. A U.S. employer sponsors you, and your spouse and children under 21 can come too.
eb3.what_intro: EB-3 is an employment-based green card with 3 subcategories:

categories.title: Skilled Workers
categories.desc: Jobs requiring at least 2 years of experience or training.

categories.title: Professionals
categories.desc: Jobs requiring a U.S. bachelor's degree or equivalent.

categories.title: Other Workers — unskilled
categories.desc: Jobs requiring less than 2 years of experience. No degree required. This is the category MannaOS supports.

eb3.where_vn_desc: Your case goes through consular processing: DS-260, medical exam, and an interview at the U.S. Consulate General in Ho Chi Minh City.
eb3.where_us_desc: You may adjust status (I-485) inside the U.S. when your date is current. Requirement: you currently hold lawful status.

steps.title: Case review
steps.desc: MannaOS reviews your information and responds within 48 hours.

steps.title: Employer matching
steps.desc: We connect you with a verified U.S. employer that fits your industry and state.

steps.title: PERM + I-140
steps.desc: The employer obtains labor certification (PERM), then files an I-140 petition for you.

steps.title: Visa Bulletin wait
steps.desc: Wait for your priority date to become current, then interview at the consulate (Vietnam) or file I-485 (U.S.).

steps.title: Green card
steps.desc: You and your family become U.S. permanent residents.

eb3.steps_note: Total time is an estimated 4–6 years, depending on the Visa Bulletin and USCIS and Department of State processing. Timelines are not guaranteed.
fit_requirements: Commitment to work for the sponsoring employer
Financial readiness for each case milestone
eb3.cost_intro: Costs are split across the milestones of your case, in 4 groups:

cost_items.title: Paid by the employer
cost_items.desc: Labor certification (PERM) and recruitment costs are paid by the employer as required by law.

cost_items.title: Attorney fees
cost_items.desc: Fees for the licensed U.S. immigration attorney who handles the legal filings.

cost_items.title: Government fees
cost_items.desc: I-140, DS-260 or I-485 filing fees, and the medical exam.

cost_items.title: MannaOS service fee
cost_items.desc: Case coordination, Vietnamese-language support, translation, and progress tracking.

faq.q: Do I need to speak English?
faq.a: The Other Workers category does not require fluent English. Basic English makes work and the interview easier.

faq.q: Can my family come with me?
faq.a: Yes. Your spouse and unmarried children under 21 can come as derivative beneficiaries.
A monthly chart published by the U.S. Department of State showing which filing dates are current. Your wait time depends on it.

faq.q: I'm in the U.S. on a tourist visa. Can I adjust status?
faq.a: It depends. The key requirement is holding lawful status when you file I-485. Send us your details for a specific review.

faq.q: I was refused a U.S. visa before. Can I still apply?
faq.a: Possibly. The reason for the prior refusal will be reviewed during case evaluation.

faq.q: Do I have to work for the sponsoring employer?
faq.a: Yes. EB-3 is based on a real job offer, and you must intend to work for the sponsoring employer after receiving your green card.
No. MannaOS provides case support and coordination. Legal filings are handled by licensed U.S. immigration attorneys.

business_faqs.q: How long does LLC setup take?
business_faqs.a: LLC formation in Texas typically takes 1-3 business days for standard processing. We handle all paperwork including EIN registration.

business_faqs.q: Can you help if I live in Vietnam?
business_faqs.a: Yes. We help owners outside the U.S. form a U.S. LLC and get an EIN. Requirements differ by state, so we confirm them with you first.

business_faqs.q: What does the business website setup include?
business_faqs.a: Domain and business email, a website design with basic SEO, and a Google Business Profile.

personal_desc: Practical help with everyday paperwork and administrative tasks in the United States.
personal_note: We help you fill out forms, prepare documents, and schedule appointments. Government agencies issue Social Security numbers, driver's licenses, and other official documents, and they decide eligibility. We cannot issue documents or guarantee an outcome, and we do not provide medical or legal advice. This service is separate from our immigration services.

personal_faqs.q: Do you issue Social Security cards or driver's licenses?
personal_faqs.a: No. The Social Security Administration and your state's driver's license office (DPS in Texas) issue them. We help you complete the forms, gather your documents, and book the appointment.

personal_faqs.q: Do I need an immigration case to use this service?
personal_faqs.a: No. This service covers everyday U.S. paperwork such as school, Social Security, driver's license, and medical appointments. It is separate from our immigration services.
